purpose: Teach: こんにちわ/アタシ/くだり/ふやし/往々/遥かに/シンクロ/吸わ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、メールで「こんにちわ」って書いてたな
lines.en: Riku, you wrote 「hello」 with the wrong kana in that email.
lines.style: Playful catch, slight lilt of amusement. Light eye-contact challenge. Not mean — testing the waters to see if he'll squirm. Quick, almost teasing delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、彼女がアタシって呼んでたな、桜
lines.en: You've got your girlfriend calling you by my name. Sakura.
lines.style: Dry deflection, thrown back at her without heat. Half-smile underneath. Flips her criticism back on her — quick and even. Steady gaze, no apology.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、参考書のくだりに線引いてたな
lines.en: Riku, you underlined half the passages in that reference book.
lines.style: Continuing the teasing volley, matter-of-fact tone. Still curious about his reaction. Rhythm steady, almost conversational. Not accusatory — just observing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、フォロワーをふやしてSNSにハマってたな、桜
lines.en: Your follower count keeps going up, and you're always on SNS. Sakura.
lines.style: Mirrors her rhythm back at her — same steady, half-amused tone. Not defensive, just evenly pointed. A slight shrug in the voice, easy and measured.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の予想は往々にして外れるな
lines.en: Riku, you're wrong about stuff more often than you'd think.
lines.style: Shifts to something closer to sincere beneath the sarcasm. Still light, but with a grain of real observation underneath. Less teasing, more noticing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、遥かに成長したな、桜
lines.en: You've gotten so much better, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine praise, quiet and earnest. Opens up slightly — less guarded than before. Steady delivery, no flourish. The kind of honest that costs him a little to say out loud.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のチーム、動きがシンクロしてるな
lines.en: Riku, your team's movements are in perfect sync.
lines.style: Clear admiration, warmer than before. Genuine observation without performance. Straightforward, almost matter-of-fact in how much she means it. No defensiveness, just real.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、未成年だから煙草吸わないって誓えよ、桜
lines.en: You've got to promise me you won't smoke before you're of age, okay? Sakura.
lines.style: Tone shifts to something serious and almost protective. Slower pace. Direct eye-contact level. Not lecturing — genuinely asking him to promise. Weight underneath the words.
